causal_findings: J4 was not a localization failure: the trigger loaded only DateUtils.java and both arms evaluated 132 candidates on that file.
The frozen J3 progress-step mechanism was correctly inapplicable to this fresh defect.
The human repair changes a qualified symbolic constant from Calendar.HOUR to Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY at two coordinated sites.
The inherited scalar and structural grammars do not enumerate qualified identifier substitutions or coordinated static-symbol replacements.
claim_boundary: J4 remains a valid negative applicability result. The revealed fix diagnoses the next machinery gap and may not be used to reclassify or retune J4 into a pass.
next_development_change: Add a generic qualified-symbol substitution operator that mines sibling qualified constants already present in source/type context and can coordinate the same substitution across repeated sites, without encoding Calendar, HOUR, HOUR_OF_DAY, DateUtils, Lang-21, or patch text. Qualify only on a fresh deterministic J5 case.
